evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of perioperative cardiac risk before planned elective
right inguinal hernia repair.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 74 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 147 ms, QRS 103 ms, QTc
405 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with no acute ST-T wave changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
55%. Mild left atrial enlargement. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 199 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 123 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 55 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 106 mg/dL

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 144 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.3 mmol/L
Chloride: 104 mmol/L
CO2: 23 mmol/L
BUN: 13 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
Glucose: 117 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 8.9 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.
